observations: Two large black upright figures dominate the left and center, each marked with red X shapes over circular eye forms and jagged tooth rows outlined in white.
A cream and tan background is cut across by broad flat strokes of blue, with loose black lines running diagonally across the full width of the image.
The right edge holds two yellow spiral forms—one tight coil mid-right, one larger concentric ring lower-right—against the tan ground, separated from the dense black figures.
reading: Two black figures, stacked and overlapping, carry repeated marks: crossed X eyes, ringed circles, and tooth-lined mouths. A smaller outlined figure sits between them, drawn in thin neon lines against the dark mass. The blue sweeps and scattered yellow zigzags push outward while the figures hold the center. The spiral forms at the right edge offer a quieter pull against the crowded interior.
